sections.Profile:
Motordome , released by Bally in 1986, is a four-player solid-state game with a motorbike racing theme, designed by Greg Kmiec with artwork by Tony Ramunni. Its playfield is built around a tall system of clear ramps with a flipper of their own on the upper level, players pick one of three skill levels before the first ball, and 2,000 were built.
